This series is not about anyone in particular, but rather what we as hunters enjoy the most.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.desc: During the 1940s, a group of young men go off to war, leaving behind Ethel Ann (Mischa Barton), who is in love with one of them, Teddy. Ethel Ann must decide whether to go with Jimmy to meet the soldier who last saw Teddy alive.

programme.title: Pioneer Justice
programme.desc: Something strange is going on in the frontier town of Buffalo Gap. After two men turn up dead, a marshal named Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) arrives, along with his partner, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), to investigate. Although the outlaw Bill Judd (Jack Ingram) seems to be behind the deaths, the sheriff is not taking any action. When Cheyenne learns the sheriff may be taking orders from another party, he and Fuzzy try to find out who is controlling the criminal element.

programme.title: Romance of the West
programme.desc: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time.

programme.title: The Tioga Kid
programme.desc: With assistance from partner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), Texas Ranger Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) helps rancher Jenny Morgan (Jennifer Holt) recover her stolen herd. For Eddie, the theft comes as a shock, as it may have been perpetrated by his twin, who is known as "the Tioga Kid" (also Dean). Suddenly, the brothers are at odds as never before. Things get even dicier when wanted posters depict a man who looks exactly like Eddie, causing some to believe that he's actually the bad guy.

programme.title: The Dawn Rider
programme.desc: John Mason (John Wayne) suffers a cruel homecoming when he witnesses his father's murder as he rides into town. Incensed, he chases after the killers, but he suffers a gunshot wound that cuts his pursuit short. Alice Gordon (Marion Burns) sees to his injury, and Mason is taken by her kindness and beauty. But things turn sour when her beau, Ben (Reed Howes), becomes jealous. After Mason discovers the men who killed his father, his plan for a duel is sabotaged by Ben, who has been manipulated.

programme.title: Check Your Guns
programme.desc: Gunslinger Eddie (Eddie Dean) rides into the Wild West town of Red Gap, Colo., which is run by land-hungry saloon owner Brad Taggert (Stan Jolley) and corrupt circuit judge Hammond (Bill Fawcett). When the sheriff is killed by members of Taggert's gang, Eddie is appointed to take his place. Along with his deputy, barbershop owner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), and ranch owner Cathy Jordan (Nancy Gates), Eddie takes aim at Taggert and his gang, led by sharpshooter Ace Bannion (Mikel Conrad).

programme.title: The Desert Trail
programme.desc: John Scott (John Wayne) is a rodeo rider, assisted by his buddy Kansas Charlie (Eddy Chandler). But while the duo is settling a debt with their promoter, Farnsworth (Henry Hall), thieves Pete (Al Ferguson) and Jim (Paul Fix) murder and rob Farnsworth and manage to pin the crimes on John and Charlie. The accused then flee, assume two new identities, take up with a shopkeeper named Anne (Mary Kornman) and set out to clear their names and bring the real killers to justice.

programme.title: Cheyenne Takes Over
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are en route to a much-needed vacation at Fuzzy's friend's ranch. But, upon arriving, the partners find that Fuzzy's pal has been killed, and a fishy group of characters has taken over the ranch, claiming to have inherited it from the dead man. Immediately suspicious, the lawmen team up with local saloon owner Fay Wilkins (Nancy Gates), and forgo their vacation in favor of a murder investigation.

programme.title: The Man From Utah
programme.desc: One day, John Weston (John Wayne) helps stop a bank robbery. George Higgins (George Hayes), the town's grateful marshal, asks Weston for his help in solving another crime. It seems someone at a touring rodeo show is killing the top riders before they can take home the trophy -- and the prize money. Weston agrees to investigate and works his way into the show, which is run by the shady Spike Barton (Edward Peil). As Weston gets closer to the truth, he finds himself in even greater danger.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: In Old Amarillo
programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

programme.title: The Trail Beyond

Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives.

programme.title: Niagara Niagara
programme.desc: Two misfits (Robin Tunney, Henry Thomas) meet while shoplifting and set out on a mission that takes a quick downward spiral.

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Three excitement-craving friends get more than they bargained for when they steal a hit woman's automobile.

programme.title: Premium
programme.desc: Reginald "Cool" Coolidge is an actor hoping for his big break away from stereotypical black roles. When his ex-fiancée, Charli, pulls in to the gas station where he works, Cool realizes that he still loves her after three years apart. But there is one problem: Charli's wedding to another man is only 36 hours away. Desperate to win her back, Cool uses his talents as an actor to convince Charli that she is choosing the wrong man.

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
programme.desc: Gunslinger and former Confederate Jim Dancer (Randolph Scott) is on a mission to find his brother's killer but mistakenly shoots the wrong man, leading him to become an outlaw. Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Ambush Trail
programme.desc: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth.

programme.title: Tornado Range
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his partner, Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), escort homesteaders into Texas to settle. Determined to resist the settlement, rancher Lance King (George Chesebro) organizes the locals, despite both the caution of his daughter, Mary (Jennifer Holt), and a government document delivered by Eddie assuring the homesteaders of their rights. As confrontation brews, criminal rancher Thayer (Terry Frost) uses the conflict as a cover to seek vengeance on King.

programme.title: Range Beyond the Blue
programme.desc: A stagecoach operator in the untamed territories of the American Southwest, Margie Rodgers (Helen Mowery) becomes a target for bandits when she starts hauling gold. Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), a pair of justice-minded cowboys, stumble across an attempt to rob one of Margie's coaches, and they save her loot from the villains. But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation.

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives.

programme.title: Frontier Fugitives
programme.desc: Ellen Williams (Lorraine Miller) has reason to be worried. Her fur-trader father has just been killed, and it looks like his murderers aim to strong-arm her into giving up the whereabouts of his stockpile of animal pelts. Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

programme.title: Man From Oklahoma
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Twilight in the Sierras
programme.desc: Parole officer Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) visits his kindhearted friend Judge Wiggins (Edward Keane) at his home for rehabilitated ex-convicts. Behind the judge's back, foreman Matt Brunner (George Meeker) has been running a counterfeiting ring with the unwilling help of former prisoner Ricardo Chavez (Russ Vincent). An accident during a lion hunt causes Deputy Sheriff Pat Callahan (Dale Evans) to arrest Roy for murder, while Brunner's henchmen kidnap Chavez's visiting sister (Estelita Rodriguez).

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
programme.desc: Gunslinger and former Confederate Jim Dancer (Randolph Scott) is on a mission to find his brother's killer but mistakenly shoots the wrong man, leading him to become an outlaw. Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown.

programme.title: Bells of Coronado
programme.desc: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Dead Birds
programme.desc: William (Henry Thomas), a Confederate soldier, has gone AWOL with a crew of other men. As the group, among it a runaway slave (Isaiah Washington) and a nurse (Nicki Aycox), makes its way along, it stops off to rob a bank clean. Looking to plan a getaway, the gang heads into an empty house to hole up for the evening. As the soldiers start arguing with one another, strange things begin happening in the house -- and everyone in the group soon realizes that the place is haunted.

programme.desc: An astronaut (John Agar) leads U.N. explorers to Uranus, where a giant eye feeds them images from their minds.

programme.title: The Satan Bug
programme.desc: Special Agent Lee Barrett (George Maharis) joins forces with Ann Williams (Anne Francis), a general's daughter, to recover a biological weapon stolen from a secret government lab. Learning that the pathogen could destroy all life on Earth, they focus their attention on a mysterious millionaire who may have orchestrated the theft. After annihilating a small town in Florida, the villain turns his attention to Los Angeles -- and the duo must race to stop the city's destruction.

programme.title: Pursuit of the Graf Spee
programme.desc: British officers chase the German pocket battleship Graf Spee to Uruguay, where its captain scuttles it.

programme.title: Night Ambush
programme.desc: With Crete controlled by German Gen. Heinrich Kreipe (Marius Goring), British Maj. Patrick Leigh Fermor (Dirk Bogarde) and Capt. W. Stanley Moss (David Oxley) launch a raid of the island. The Englishmen, backed by rebel forces who have fought against the occupying troops throughout World War II, ambush a Nazi roadblock and seize Kreipe. Charged with the task of transporting their hostage to a British base in Egypt, Fermor and Moss must elude a host of armed Germans intent on freeing Kreipe.

programme.title: The Devil's 8
programme.desc: A federal agent (Christopher George) trains escaped chain-gang convicts for a mission to bust a Southern moonshine racket.

programme.title: Code 46
programme.desc: In a dystopian future, insurance fraud investigator William Gold (Tim Robbins) arrives in Shanghai to investigate a forgery ring for "papelles," futuristic passports that record people's identities and genetics. Gold falls for Maria Gonzalez (Samantha Morton), the woman in charge of the forgeries. After a passionate affair, Gold returns home, having named a coworker as the culprit. But when one of Gonzalez's customers is found dead, Gold is sent back to Shanghai to complete the investigation.

programme.title: Five Steps to Danger
programme.desc: Hitchhiking on a deserted New Mexico road after his car breaks down, John Emmett (Sterling Hayden) gets picked up by Ann Nicholson (Ruth Roman), who is in a rush to reach Santa Fe, N.M. The distraught Ann is being pursued by psychiatrist Frederick Simmons (Werner Klemperer), who has been treating her in Los Angeles since she had a nervous breakdown, but she tells John that she is in possession of nuclear secrets that she must deliver to Dr. Reinhart Kissel (Karl Lindt) at a Santa Fe university.

programme.title: China Doll
programme.desc: Pilot Cliff Brandon (Victor Mature) flies missions from China in support of troops in the Pacific Theater, but is depressed by his situation and takes to excessive drinking. After one late-night binge, he finds that a young woman named Shu-Jen (Li Hua Li) has been either sold or betrothed to him. Brandon is reluctant to acknowledge the relationship, but he finds himself increasingly eager to return to Shu-Jen. When she becomes pregnant, his priorities change dramatically.

programme.title: The Tender
programme.desc: After his wife overdoses and dies, Bobby (John Travolta) raises his daughter (Ellie Raab) by himself in Chicago, while she spends her time nursing a dog back to health. Finding a job through his brother-in-law, Cissy (Tito Larriva), Bobby earns money working for the Mafia. However, Cissy, who blames Bobby for his sister's death, sets him up as a fall guy. Bobby manages to flee with his daughter, but the Mafia is right behind -- and so is the dog, who remains loyal to the girl.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Coming home at the end of World War I, Matt Brady (John Payne), the black-sheep brother of big-city political boss Tim Brady (Roy Roberts), is a loose cannon who gets into drunken fights and impulsively marries a total stranger, the plain but kind-hearted Lorry (Gloria McGhee). Taking over his brother's political machine after Tim's sudden death, Matt becomes powerful and extremely wealthy, but his corrupt dealings with a local gangster (Robin Morse) threaten to destroy everything he has.

programme.title: Cloudburst
programme.desc: Canadian World War II veteran John Graham (Robert Preston) works in London as a code breaker. Tragedy strikes when his pregnant wife, Carol (Elizabeth Sellars), is accidentally run over by two crooks who are speeding away from the scene of a murder. Haunted, grieving and thirsting for revenge, Graham sets out to find the two fugitive murderers. When he does, he intends to kill them, the same way they killed Carol. But will that assuage his grief?

programme.title: Crime Against Joe
programme.desc: Joe, an unemployed artist living with his mother, is suspected of murdering bar singer Irene Crescent during a drinking binge. His alibi -- that he ran into a sleepwalker and helped her home -- is denied by the sleepwalker's father. A friend, waitress Slacks, who is secretly in love with him, comes to his aid with a false alibi. When it doesn't hold up, Joe and Slacks must go in search of the real killer themselves.

programme.title: The Last Mile

programme.title: The Wild Party
programme.desc: Embittered ex-NFL pro Tom Kupfen (Anthony Quinn) has taken to hanging with a group of go-nowhere beatniks, including good-schoolgirl-gone-bad Honey (Kathryn Grant), hopped-up jazz musician Kicks Johnson (Nehemiah Persoff) and ticking time bomb Gage Freeposter (Jay Robinson). programme.desc: A small-town young man (Christopher Lee) rises in social standing, haunted by nightmares of murder.

programme.title: The Black Tent
programme.desc: An Englishman (Donald Sinden) learns his army brother (Anthony Steel) married a Bedouin (Anna-Maria Sandri) and fought the Nazis as a guerrilla.

programme.title: The Big Boodle
programme.desc: Cuban crooks and police chase a casino card dealer (Errol Flynn) for counterfeit pesos and plates.

programme.title: Portrait in Terror

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Franz von Werra (Hardy Kruger) is a Luftwaffe pilot by trade, but an escape artist by necessity. When his plane is attacked over England, he initiates his first effort to break out of the POW camp only days after arriving. Transferred to a second, more secure facility, Franz nevertheless manages to tunnel out and very nearly steals an airplane before being recaptured. This time the Allies send him to be imprisoned in Canada, but he steadfastly insists that no cell will hold him.

programme.title: Beachhead
programme.desc: During World War II, four Marines land on a Pacific island to execute the rescue of French planter Bouchard (Eduard Franz) and his daughter, Nina (Mary Murphy). With Japanese soldiers hidden throughout the dense jungle landscape, the Marines face a daunting trek to reach their target and must endure even greater danger on the return trip with the two French citizens. In the end, one of the Marines, Burke (Tony Curtis), carries the responsibility of getting everyone to safety.

programme.title: Ten Seconds to Hell
programme.desc: After the end of World War II, six German soldiers return to Berlin and form a bomb disposal unit. Defusing bombs is extremely risky business, so every week the group contributes to a fund that will go to the last man standing. Only Karl Wirtz and Eric Koertner are left, and their once solid friendship is starting to crack. Adding to the tension is their rivalry over a local woman and one last job that could change everything.

programme.title: The Purple Plain
programme.desc: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again.

programme.title: Kings Go Forth
programme.desc: During World War II, in a picturesque town on the French Riviera, U.S. Army Lt. Sam Loggins (Frank Sinatra) and Cpl. Britt Harris (Tony Curtis) both fall for the same local girl, the American-born Monique Blair (Natalie Wood). But when the soldiers learn that Monique and her mother (Leora Dana) had moved to France from the United States to escape discrimination against her parents' interracial marriage, each man must examine his own bigotry and prejudices.

programme.title: The Young Savages
programme.desc: After a Puerto Rican teen is murdered by three white adolescents, the case comes to Assistant District Attorney Hank Bell (Burt Lancaster). Realizing that he used to date the mother (Shelley Winters) of one of the suspects, he wonders if the boy is his son. Despite Bell's personal involvement, the district attorney (Edward Andrews) keeps him on the case. However, as Bell discovers street gang involvement in the case, he and his wife (Dina Merrill) begin to face physical threats.

programme.title: The Large Rope
programme.desc: An innocent ex-con becomes a two-time loser when he finds himself the scapegoat in the murder of a disreputable female.

programme.title: Cast a Giant Shadow
programme.desc: In this fact-based film, distinguished U.S. Army Col. David Marcus (Kirk Douglas) is enlisted by the Israelis to perform the difficult task of preparing their fledgling nation for battle against the Arabs. Before long, he feuds with the local leaders, quits his post and goes back home to his pregnant wife (Angie Dickinson) in the United States. However, Marcus, who is Jewish himself, soon has a crisis of faith and decides to return to duty to help the untrained Israelis form an army.

programme.title: Kiss Me, Stupid
programme.desc: When popular singer Dino (Dean Martin) stops for gas in a small town near Las Vegas, mechanic Barney (Cliff Osmond) disables his car. Barney, who writes songs with local teacher Orville (Ray Walston), wants Dino to sing some of their compositions. Orville invites Dino over, but sends his wife, Zelda (Felicia Farr), away so Dino can't hit on her. He then hires prostitute Polly (Kim Novak) to play his wife. Meanwhile, Zelda goes to a bar, where she gets drunk and eventually meets a lonely Dino.

programme.title: Guns, Girls and Gangsters
programme.desc: A Las Vegas singer (Mamie Van Doren) plans an armored-car robbery with her husband's (Lee Van Cleef) ex-cellmate (Gerald Mohr).

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

programme.title: The Killer Is Loose
programme.desc: Humble bank teller Leon Poole (Wendell Corey) participates in a heist that doesn't go as planned. When police surround his apartment, there's a shoot-out, during which Detective Sam Wagner (Joseph Cotten) unwittingly kills Poole's wife. Poole is subsequently captured and jailed, but three years later he's back out on the street and hell-bent on revenge. Wanting the punishment to fit the crime, he vows that he won't kill Wagner -- just his wife (Rhonda Fleming).

programme.title: A Story of David: The Hunted
programme.desc: Renowned for his courageous deeds as a youth when he slew Goliath, David (Jeff Chandler) inadvertently incurs the wrath of King Saul (Basil Sydney), who is jealous of the hero's popularity. In order to provide peace of mind for the Israelite king, Saul's scheming counselor, Doeg (Peter Arne), encourages the ruler to have David killed. David, aided by his friend Jonathan (David Knight), who is Saul's own son, attempts to survive without overtly clashing with his own people.

programme.title: The Sharkfighters
programme.desc: Navy pilot Ben Staves (Victor Mature) arrives at a research facility on a small Caribbean island to help develop a shark repellent for use by sailors and downed airmen. Partnered with scientists Leonard Evans (Philip Coolidge) and Harold Duncan (James Olson), Staves provides valuable information about his own time stranded in the ocean. But his impatient desire to finish the project quickly conflicts with the researchers' methodical precision, with potentially deadly results.

programme.title: Time Limit
programme.desc: Maj. Cargill (Richard Basehart) is accused of aiding his captors while held in a North Korean prison during the war and brought up on charges of treason. Col. William Edwards (Richard Widmark) has been assigned to defend the major in his court-martial, but it's not an easy case for the colonel. More than a dozen witnesses are prepared to testify against Cargill, and the major himself admits his guilt. But Edwards begins to suspect that the major is innocent and covering up for someone else.

programme.title: The Pride and the Passion
programme.desc: During the Napoleonic Wars, retreating Spanish forces shove a powerful cannon off a cliff to prevent the French from stealing it. The British send Capt. Anthony Turnbull (Cary Grant) to help the Spanish recapture it. When he arrives in Spain, Turnbull finds the cannon secured by Spanish rebels. As Turnbull and the rebel leader Miguel (Frank Sinatra) struggle to transport the cumbersome cannon through the mountains, the British officer falls for beautiful Spaniard Juana (Sophia Loren).

programme.desc: Sgt. Truman (Stanley Baker), a policeman who deals with juvenile delinquents, visits the Murphy household after a theft by the young twins, Mary and Patrick. programme.title: The 7th Dawn
programme.desc: After World War II, Ferris (William Holden) remains in Malaya and becomes a successful businessman. Soon, Ferris encounters a man named Ng (Tetsuro Tamba), who served with him during the war and is now a communist committed to revolution for the guerillas. After Dhana is arrested, Ferris makes a deal to track down Ng in order to save her.

programme.title: Shake Hands With the Devil
programme.desc: In 1921, Kerry O'Shea (Don Murray), an American medical student living in Ireland, learns that his esteemed professor, Sean Lenihan (James Cagney), is also a leader in Ireland's rebel army. Even though Kerry's father and roommate have both been killed by British troops, he refuses to join the Irish rebellion. However, after Kerry is unjustly imprisoned and tortured by the British "Black and Tans" special forces, he fully commits himself to the cause of Irish freedom.

programme.title: Killer's Kiss
programme.desc: Davey Gordon (Jamie Smith), a New York City boxer aging out of his profession, meets dancer Gloria Price (Irene Kane), and they begin a romance. The two decide to skip town, but before they can, Vincent and his thugs abduct Gloria, and Davey is forced to search for her among the most squalid corners of the city, with his enemy hiding in the shadows.

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

programme.title: How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying
programme.desc: J. Pierpont Finch is a lowly window cleaner with dreams of making it big in the business world. After finding a copy of the book "How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying," Finch decides to apply the tactics in the book to his own life. Soon, he's working as a mail-room clerk at the World Wide Wicket Company and quickly fighting his way up the corporate ladder with relative ease in this quirky musical based on the hit Broadway production.

programme.title: Violent Playground
programme.desc: Sgt. Truman (Stanley Baker), a policeman who deals with juvenile delinquents, visits the Murphy household after a theft by the young twins, Mary and Patrick. There he meets their older sister, Cathie (Anne Heywood), and soon begins a romantic involvement with her. However, Cathie's brother, Johnnie (David McCallum), is the leader of an infamous local gang, and doesn't like to see his sister with a cop. Gradually, Truman starts to see a link between Johnnie and a string of local arsons.

programme.title: The 7th Dawn
programme.desc: After World War II, Ferris (William Holden) remains in Malaya and becomes a successful businessman. He enjoys a quiet existence with his Malayan girlfriend, Dhana (Capucine), although a politician's daughter named Candace (Susannah York) also fancies him. Soon, Ferris encounters a man named Ng (Tetsuro Tamba), who served with him during the war and is now a communist committed to revolution for the guerillas. After Dhana is arrested, Ferris makes a deal to track down Ng in order to save her.

programme.title: Shake Hands With the Devil
programme.desc: In 1921, Kerry O'Shea (Don Murray), an American medical student living in Ireland, learns that his esteemed professor, Sean Lenihan (James Cagney), is also a leader in Ireland's rebel army. Even though Kerry's father and roommate have both been killed by British troops, he refuses to join the Irish rebellion. However, after Kerry is unjustly imprisoned and tortured by the British "Black and Tans" special forces, he fully commits himself to the cause of Irish freedom.

programme.title: Killer's Kiss
programme.desc: Davey Gordon (Jamie Smith), a New York City boxer aging out of his profession, meets dancer Gloria Price (Irene Kane), and they begin a romance. However, their budding relationship is interrupted by Gloria's violent boss, Vincent Rapallo (Frank Silvera), who has eyes for his employee. The two decide to skip town, but before they can, Vincent and his thugs abduct Gloria, and Davey is forced to search for her among the most squalid corners of the city, with his enemy hiding in the shadows.

programme.title: Deadly Impact
programme.desc: After a brilliant killer once again resurfaces, a cop (Sean Patrick Flanery) joins forces with the FBI to bring the psychopath to justice.

programme.desc: On their 13th wedding anniversary, long-simmering tensions between Manhattan businessman Chris Walters (David Niven) and his homemaker wife, Alice (Mitzi Gaynor), explode with the arrival of a new television set from Alice's well-meaning but meddlesome parents (Loring Smith, Phyllis Povah). Tired of Chris's explosive temper and embarrassed by his drunken admission to her parents that they had been intimate prior to their wedding night, Alice debates leaving her husband.

programme.title: Never on Sunday
programme.desc: Free spirit and prostitute Ilya (Melina Mercouri) lives in a Greek port city. Open and amiable, she makes friends often and easily. She encounters Homer Thrace (Jules Dassin), a vacationing American who is obsessed with ancient Greek culture. Homer feels that modern Greece is a shadow of its former self, and he believes that Ilya is a prime example of contemporary decadence. He makes it his goal to amend Ilya's easygoing ways, but she has stronger principles than Homer expected.

programme.title: The Knack... and How to Get It
programme.desc: Desperate to improve his luck with women, London schoolteacher Colin (Michael Crawford) enlists his artist roommate, Tom (Donal Donnelly), to help drag a brass bed back to their flat. Along the way they meet Nancy (Rita Tushingham), a new girl in town, who follows them home. There they encounter Tolen (Ray Brooks), the third roommate and a consummate lady-killer. He tries to help Colin seduce Nancy, but ends up whisking her away on his motorcycle instead, and Colin is determined to get her back.

programme.title: The First Time

programme.title: The First Power
programme.desc: A Los Angeles policeman (Lou Diamond Phillips) hunts a killer (Jeff Kober) brought back from the gas chamber by Satan.

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elija Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

programme.title: Sugar Hill
programme.desc: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail.

programme.title: Catch the Heat
programme.desc: An agent (Tiana Alexandra) works as an exotic dancer to nab a drug smuggler (Rod Steiger) who hides heroin in breast implants.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: Article 99
programme.desc: Dr. Richard Sturgess (Ray Liotta) leads a team of compassionate doctors at a veteran's hospital. Along with Drs. Morgan (Kiefer Sutherland), Handleman (Forest Whitaker) and Van Dorn (Lea Thompson), he fights to deliver adequate care to needy veterans in the face of funding cuts and a corrupt administration. To succeed, the staff may have to bend the rules and circumvent the villainous "Article 99," a bureaucratic loophole that prevents veterans from receiving the benefits they deserve.

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.desc: Soldiers Paul Aubert and Jean Renaud attempt to make their escape from a Nazi prison camp, but only Jean makes it out alive. When Jean is dispatched to deliver the sad news to Paul's wife, Marise, he begins a budding romance with the recently widowed woman. Then Paul, injured but still very much alive, sends word that he is coming to reunite with his wife, putting a damper on Jean's plans to start a new life with Marise.

programme.title: The Great Lie
programme.desc: After her long-time boyfriend, pilot Pete Van Allen (George Brent), marries fiery concert pianist Sandra Kovak (Mary Astor) while drunk, Maggie Patterson (Bette Davis) is heartbroken. Pete learns the marriage is illegal, yet dutifully offers to remarry Sandra. But when she refuses to alter a performance date to do so, Pete returns to Maggie and marries her. Soon after, Pete goes missing on a flight -- and when Maggie learns Sandra is carrying Pete's baby, she makes the pianist a shocking offer.

programme.title: Random Harvest
programme.desc: A veteran of World War I, Charles Rainier (Ronald Colman) has lost all memory of his life before the war. Left to wander, Rainier meets a showgirl, Paula (Greer Garson), with whom he falls in love. Rainier and Paula are soon happily married, but when Rainier travels out of town, a car hits him -- erasing the memories of his life with Paula, but restoring those of his life before the war. While he returns to his previous life, Paula tries to find a way to be reunited with her husband.

programme.title: I Know Where I'm Going!
programme.desc: Plucky Englishwoman Joan Webster travels to the remote islands of the Scottish Hebrides in order to marry a wealthy industrialist. Trapped by inclement weather on the Isle of Mull and unable to continue to her destination, Joan finds herself charmed by the straightforward, no-nonsense islanders around her, and becomes increasingly attracted to naval officer Torquil MacNeil, who holds a secret that may change her life forever.

programme.title: Dark Victory
programme.desc: Socialite Judith Traherne (Bette Davis) lives a lavish but emotionally empty life. Riding horses is one of her few joys, and her stable master (Humphrey Bogart) is secretly in love with her. Told she has a brain tumor by her doctor, Frederick Steele (George Brent), Judith becomes distraught. After she decides to have surgery to remove the tumor, Judith realizes she is in love with Dr. Steele, but more troubling medical news may sabotage her new relationship, and her second chance at life.

Championed by sportswriter Sam Blake (Walter Brennan), Gehrig eventually gets recruited by the New York Yankees, joining a team of heavy hitters that includes the legendary Babe Ruth. When Gehrig marries his spirited sweetheart, Eleanor (Teresa Wright), things look up for him, but he is soon sidelined by a terrible illness that he bravely tries to battle.

Once he recovers, he and Aimee wed, and he returns to baseball and begins an increasingly successful career -- until he's diagnosed with epilepsy, which he struggles to hide from the public and Aimee.

programme.title: America 250
programme.sub-title: Tour of the U.S.S. Arlington Tribute Room
programme.desc: C-SPAN tours the Pentagon attack tribute room on the U.S.S. Arlington, one of three 9/11 memorial ships, as it makes its way to Baltimore for America's 250th birthday celebrations.

programme.title: The History of the Space Program
programme.desc: In 1957, the beeps from Sputnik, a small Russian satellite, sent the USSR & US into a space race. Teasel Muir-Harmony of the Air & Space Museum chronicles the history of space travel and how the U.S. landed on the Moon and how we're going back in 20.

programme.title: Q & A
programme.sub-title: Former NASA Flight Director Eugene Kranz on the History of America's Space Program
programme.desc: Eugene Gene Kranz shares stories from his 34 years at NASA's Mission Control, beginning in 1960 with his work on Project Mercury, the first American human spaceflight program and later as flight director for NASA's Gemini and Apollo programs.

programme.title: History of the Space Shuttle Program
programme.desc: C-SPAN's American History TV visits the Air & Space Museum's Udvar-Hazy Center to get an up-close look at the Space Shuttle Discovery and explore the history of the shuttle program.

programme.title: Reel America
programme.sub-title: Women Working in NASA's Space Program - 1981
programme.desc: Narrated by Ricardo Montalban, this 1981 NASA film features women employed by NASA in a variety of specialized fields.

programme.title: Reel America
programme.desc: 1979 NASA film about the history of efforts to explore Mars including the 1964-1971 Mariner fly-bys and the Viking landings in 1976.

programme.title: C-SPAN Tours the National Air & Space Museum
programme.desc: C-SPAN tours the Smithsonian's National Air & Space Museum in Washington, D.C., where we look at Apollo 11's lunar lander, Charles Lindbergh's plane that flew across the Atlantic, the X-15 that Neil Armstrong flew, and much more.

programme.title: Anita McBride on First Lady Bess Truman
programme.desc: Anita McBride, who served as chief of staff to First Lady Laura Bush, reflects on the life and legacy of First Lady Bess Truman (1945-53). Her essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to mark America's 250th birthday in 2026.

programme.desc: Historian and author Marilyn Holt reflects on the life and legacy of First Lady Mamie Eisenhower (1953-61). Her essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to mark America's 250th birthday in 2026.

The contestant who has the most money at the end of the game goes on to the bonus round to potentially earn more cash.

Il y a vingt-cinq ans, le justicier surpuissant de Granite City, Samaritan, a été déclaré mort après une bataille enflammée dans un entrepôt avec son rival, Nemesis. La plupart pensent qu'il a péri dans l'incendie, mais certains, comme Sam, espèrent qu'il est toujours en vie.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Quand une série de meurtres cruels terrorise Londres, il ne faut pas longtemps pour le légendaire détective Sherlock Holmes et son partenaire d'enquêtes le Dr Watson pour trouver le tueur, Lord Blackwood. Adepte des forces du mal, Blackwood a un projet plus important en tête.

programme.title: Tuer Bill, volume 1
programme.desc: Au cours d'une cérémonie de mariage en plein désert, un commando fait irruption dans la chapelle et tire sur les convives. Laissée pour morte, la mariée enceinte retrouve ses esprits après un coma de quatre ans. Celle qui a auparavant exercé les fonctions de tueuse à gages au sein du Détachement international des Vipères assassines n'a alors plus qu'une seule idée en tête: venger la mort de ses proches en éliminant tous les membres de cette organisation criminelle.

programme.title: Tuer Bill, volume 2
programme.desc: La Mariée, après avoir tué deux de ses anciens complices, poursuit sa vengeance contre ceux qui ont massacré sa famille, notamment le fameux Bill, son ancien commanditaire. C'est la renaissance d'un personnage terrassant d'émotion, effectuant un véritable chemin de croix.

programme.title: Le moineau rouge
programme.desc: La ballerine Dominika Egorova fait face à l'incertitude lorsqu'une blessure met fin à sa carrière de danseuse. Elle se tourne vers l'école Sparrow, un service d'intelligence secrète qui entraîne des jeunes filles exceptionnelles à utiliser leurs esprits et corps comme armes. Egorova en devient la Sparrow la plus dangereuse après avoir complété la formation sadique. Alors qu'elle s'habitue à ses nouvelles capacités, Dominika rencontre un agent de la CIA.

programme.title: Tina
programme.desc: Born Anna Mae Bullock in 1939, Tina Turner has sold in excess of 100 million records and earned numerous plaudits including Grammy awards and induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame with her first husband, Ike Turner. She was the first woman to grace the cover of Rolling Stone magazine and dabbled in acting including a memorable performance opposite Mel Gibson in Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome. Following a prolonged period of ill health, Turner intends to retire from the spotlight with her second husband, Erwin Bach. She bids farewell to her fans in the emotional documentary Tina. Directed by Dan Lindsay and TJ Martin, the film invites the singer to reminisce about her turbulent life and career with glowing contributions from friends, family and fans including Oprah Winfrey and Angela Bassett.

programme.title: Amy
programme.desc: Documentary portrait of soul, jazz and R'n'B singer-songwriter Amy Winehouse, whose untimely death in July 2011 followed a well-publicised history of drugs and alcohol abuse. Director Asif Kapadia traces Amy's rise and demise over the 13 years preceding her death, telling her story via her music and autobiographical song lyrics, video footage shot by friends and family, archive television clips, plus voiceover interviews with those who were personally and professionally close to her. Contributors include Pete Doherty, Mitch Winehouse, Tony Bennett, Mark Ronson and Tyler James.

This documentary re-examines the case, featuring interviews with those convinced Robin was wrongfully convicted and others who are unsure and still suspect he is guilty.

programme.title: Black Phone 2
programme.desc: Four years after a serial killer prowled the streets of North Denver, posing as a magician to lure unsuspecting children into the back of his van, teenager Finney tries to adjust to a normal life. However, the lethal Grabber returns, and is bent on revenge. Horror thriller, starring Ethan Hawke and Mason Thames.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends travel to a remote woodland cabin, hoping one of them can conquer her drug addiction by going cold turkey. They uncover a mysterious book that, when read, unleashes demonic forces that possess the living and transform them into bloodthirsty zombies. Horror remake, starring Jane Levy and Shiloh Fernandez.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Eric and Shelly meet in rehabilitation and fall in love. When a ruthless criminal has them murdered, Eric is resurrected and granted supernatural powers. Guided by a mysterious spirit, he hunts those responsible through an underworld, hoping his vengeance will give him one chance to save Shelly's soul from damnation. Dark fantasy based on James O'Barr's cult comic book, starring Bill Skarsgård, FKA twigs, Danny Huston and Josette Simon.

programme.title: Him
programme.desc: Cameron Cade is predicted to be the next great quarterback of American football. During a night-time training session, he suffers a traumatic brain injury. Cameron agrees to attend a week-long boot camp run by retiring star quarterback Isaiah White at his secluded desert compound. However, Cade's life soon turns into a nightmare. Supernatural horror, starring Marlon Wayans and Tyriq Withers.

programme.title: Ick
programme.desc: A science teacher's life changes when he reconnects with his first love and suspects a new student is his daughter, all while facing an alien threat in their town. Sci-fi comedy drama, starring Brandon Routh, Mena Suvari and Malina Pauli Weissman.

programme.title: The Accursed
programme.desc: A woman named Elly is asked by family friend Alma to look after an elderly lady living in a remote cabin for a few days. She agrees, but soon discovers there is a demon hiding in the woman, waiting to break free. Horror, starring Mena Suvari, Sarah Grey and Meg Foster.

programme.title: I Don't Understand You
programme.desc: Stranded in rural Italy, an American couple on the verge of adopting tries to reconnect during a disastrous vacation. Comedic horror, starring Nick Kroll, Andrew Rannells and Amanda Seyfried.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby.

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long.

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: An unambitious 29-year-old man recently dumped and trapped in the job from hell decides to get his life back on track. Unfortunately, he has to put his plans on hold when zombies rise from their graves and stalk the streets of London to feast on the living. Comedy horror, starring Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Kate Ashfield, Dylan Moran, Lucy Davis, Bill Nighy and Penelope Wilton.

programme.title: Presence
programme.desc: A family become convinced they are not alone after moving into their new home in the suburbs. Steven Soderbergh's horror thriller, starring Lucy Liu, Chris Sullivan, Callina Liang and Eddy Maday.

programme.title: M3GAN 2.0
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the robot M3GAN went rogue and almost killed her creator, engineer Gemma Forrester. M3GAN's specs are leaked to a defence contractor to create the ultimate undercover asset, an Autonomous Military Engagement Logistics and Infiltration Android, aka AMELIA. Like her predecessor, AMELIA becomes self-aware and rebels against her human masters with deadly force. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Violet McGraw, Jemaine Clement and Allison Williams.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Eric and Shelly meet in rehabilitation and fall in love. When a ruthless criminal has them murdered, Eric is resurrected and granted supernatural powers. Guided by a mysterious spirit, he hunts those responsible through an underworld, hoping his vengeance will give him one chance to save Shelly's soul from damnation. Dark fantasy based on James O'Barr's cult comic book, starring Bill Skarsgård, FKA twigs, Danny Huston and Josette Simon.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: A crook and his unhinged brother take a preacher's family hostage and cross the border into Mexico. They head to a rough strip club to make a planned rendezvous with a third party - but they soon have to live on their wits when they realise that the establishment's staff are vampires. Horror, starring George Clooney, Harvey Keitel, Quentin Tarantino, Juliette Lewis and Salma Hayek.

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long.

C’est le plus grand rassemblement au monde de camping-cars. Chaque année, Quartzsite, une petite ville d’Arizona, située au cœur du désert à 350 kilomètres de Las Vegas, accueille près d’un million de camping-caristes. Riches, pauvres, ou appartenant à la classe moyenne, ces Américains passionnés par la vie nomade se retrouvent sur plusieurs dizaines d’hectares dans un décor typique de l’ouest américain. 
Certains arrivent à bord de petits vans, simplement aménagés. D’autres conduisent des motor-homes de luxe à plusieurs millions de dollars, avec sol en marbre, chambre de maître et lit « king-size », chambres d’amis, salles de bains avec douche à l’italienne, toilettes chauffantes, cuisine équipée, climatisation... 
Le phénomène des camping-cars est en pleine expansion aux États-Unis : plus de douze millions d’Américains en possèdent un aujourd’hui. Rien qu’en 2020, l’année du début du Covid, les commandes ont grimpé de 53%. 
Pour beaucoup, comme la famille Huffaker, c’est un choix de vie : depuis cinq ans, cet ancien informaticien et sa femme vivent sur les routes. Ils sont ce que l’on appelle des « snowbirds », des « oiseaux migrateurs ». 
Pour d’autres, c’est une nécessité : quand leur food-truck a fait faillite, Jackie et Richard se sont retrouvés à la rue. Depuis, ils vivent dans leur monospace. Et aux États-Unis, le business n’est jamais bien loin. 
Pour Curt, propriétaire de onze concessions automobiles à l’ouest du pays, ce rassemblement est une occasion en or. En neuf jours, il espère vendre deux-cent-cinquante véhicules, un quart de son chiffre d’affaires de l’année. 
Les reporters d’Enquête exclusive vous dévoilent les coulisses de ce rassemblement unique au monde.

programme.title: Enquête exclusive
programme.desc:
Longtemps présenté comme le champion européen du multiculturalisme, le Royaume-Uni traverse aujourd'hui une crise identitaire sans précédent : pour une partie des Britanniques, l'immigration serait devenue incontrôlable et les autorités auraient perdu la maîtrise de leurs frontières.
Le bouleversement est tel que même le Parti travailliste, historiquement favorable à l'immigration, a durci son discours et multiplie les arrestations de sans-papiers.
Sur les côtes de la Manche, nous avons embarqué avec Ryan Bridge, un chef d'entreprise devenu militant anti-immigration. Avec son mouvement Raise the Colours, il traque les embarcations de migrants et n’hésite pas à provoquer les garde-côtes britanniques qu’il considère comme des traîtres.
À Bournemouth, la colère est devenue quotidienne. Des hôtels accueillant des demandeurs d'asile sont régulièrement pris pour cible par des manifestants. Face à eux, Duri, un réfugié politique turc, nous a ouvert les portes de son quotidien. Entre l’apprentissage de l'anglais et le bénévolat qu’il effectue auprès des sans-abris, il rêve simplement d'obtenir le droit de travailler et de s'intégrer.
Mais en Grande-Bretagne, immigration ne rime pas forcément avec intégration. À Bradford, dans le nord du pays, les différentes communautés ne se côtoient plus vraiment. Aux côtés d’Harun, un agent immobilier prospère qui roule en Bentley et qui est également l’un des imams les plus influents de la ville, nous avons plongé au cœur d’une communauté pakistanaise qui a développé ses propres commerces, ses lieux de culte et même des « Shariah Councils », sortes de tribunaux civils chargés de régler certains conflits familiaux. Une immersion surprenante dans le multiculturalisme britannique.
Enfin, nous avons enquêté sur le scandale des grooming gangs, l'une des affaires les plus explosives du Royaume-Uni. Pendant des années, des centaines de jeunes filles ont été exploitées sexuellement, en grande partie par des hommes d'origine pakistanaise. Selon l'ancienne inspectrice Maggie Oliver, les autorités ont longtemps passé sous silence ces crimes par peur d'être accusées de racisme et de fragiliser le modèle multiculturel. Pour beaucoup de Britanniques, cette affaire est devenue le symbole d'un mensonge d'État et explique en partie la défiance actuelle envers l'immigration, un sentiment désormais largement exploité par les mouvements d'extrême droite.
Mais si le rejet des migrants progresse, des pans entiers de l'économie ne peuvent plus fonctionner sans eux. En Écosse, un éleveur de 1 200 vaches emploie des travailleurs venus des Philippines, d'Australie ou de Nouvelle-Zélande. Sans cette main-d'œuvre étrangère, son exploitation agricole mettrait la clé sous la porte.
Immersion au cœur d'un Royaume-Uni profondément fracturé, où immigration, identité, religion et sécurité sont devenues les lignes de faille d'une nation en pleine crise.

programme.title: La roue de la fortune
programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Trouver une consonne leur rapporte de l'argent, tandis que les voyelles sont payantes. À la fin de la cinquième manche, celui ayant amassé le plus d'argent accède à la finale, ce qui lui offre le droit de revenir le lendemain. Lors de la finale, il peut remporter jusqu'à 20 000 euros ou un voyage, à condition de résoudre une ultime énigme en seulement 10 secondes !

programme.title: La meilleure cuisine régionale, c'est chez moi !

Leur but : partager et faire découvrir la plus typique, la plus gourmande, la plus authentique des spécialités locales afin de remporter le titre de meilleur restaurant de leur région. Une compétition faites de secrets culinaires, d’astuces incroyables, de folklore et d’émotion auprès de ceux qui font vivre l’identité gastronomique de nos régions !

programme.desc: L'amour est dans le pré revient avec une 21e saison qui fait le choix de placer chaque agriculteur au cœur d'une aventure qui lui ressemble. Quatorze agriculteurs, âgés de 24 à 64 ans, venus de toute la France et porteurs d'histoires aussi différentes que touchantes, se lancent dans cette quête de l'amour. Véritable confidente, Karine Le Marchand les accompagne, les conseille et les soutient dans les moments de doute, des speed-datings aux voyages en amoureux.

programme.title: Familles de paysans, 100 ans d'histoire
programme.desc: De l’entre-deux-guerres à aujourd’hui, des images d’archives centenaires aux témoignages de six familles d’agriculteurs, ce documentaire, porté par Karine Le Marchand, retrace les bouleversements du monde agricole. En 100 ans, les agriculteurs ont vu se refaçonner leur métier : ils sont passés de la charrue au tracteur commandé par GPS, du fumier aux pesticides puis au bio, ils ont dû mécaniser leur exploitation, et produire toujours plus dans une logique industrielle. La France comptait plus de 2 millions de fermes avant-guerre, il y en a moins de 400 000 aujourd’hui. « Familles de paysans » retrace 100 ans de la grande histoire agricole à travers le destin et les souvenirs de six familles d’agriculteurs.

programme.title: Scènes de ménages 20h30
programme.desc: Votre couple vous désole ? Vous vous lamentez de vivre seul ? Scènes de Ménages va vous aider à relativiser !

Un couple tente de rénover seul sa maison pour y célébrer son mariage, mais accumule les catastrophes domestiques. Sue est victime d'un AVC et choisit Maddie pour assurer son intérim à la tête du centre d'appels, ce qui crée des tensions avec Josh. May, en pleine réflexion sur son avenir, remet en question son projet de devenir avocate. Buck refuse de parler du traumatisme de son enlèvement.

Un homme se présente au commissariat en affirmant avoir été assassiné avant de s'effondrer. Athena enquête sur cet empoisonnement lié à un journaliste d'investigation. Buck lutte en secret contre une dépendance aux opioïdes après son accident. La 118 se précipite sur les lieux d'un accident de voiture impliquant une mère et son fils.

L’unité 118 se mobilise lorsqu'un accident de poids lourd transportant des millions d'abeilles tueuses entraîne la libération d’un essaim géant dans les rues de Los Angeles, qui sème la panique et s’attaque aux habitants.

Athena est chargée d'escorter en avion Dennis Jenkins, un prisonnier qui doit témoigner dans une affaire très médiatisée. Le vol tourne à la catastrophe lorsque l’appareil est percuté en plein vol par un avion de tourisme et que le commandant de bord disparaît dans les airs...

Athena est chargée d'escorter en avion Dennis Jenkins, un prisonnier qui doit témoigner dans une affaire très médiatisée. Le vol tourne à la catastrophe lorsque l’appareil est percuté en plein vol par un avion de tourisme et que le commandant de bord disparaît dans les airs...

Athena tente l'impossible pour sauver tous les passagers de l'avion. Elle doit impérativement faire atterrir l'avion avant qu'il ne s'écrase avec l'aide à distance de la tour de contrôle et de la 118 au sol.

programme.sub-title: S8 E4 - La chasse aux tigres
programme.desc: Lorsque Hen et Karen semblent enfin pouvoir récupérer leur agrément de famille d'accueil, elles se heurtent à un nouvel obstacle. La 118 se porte au secours d'un cheerleader victime d’un choc sur le terrain.

programme.title: La France a un incroyable talent
programme.desc:
Pour la première fois de son histoire, La France a un incroyable talent s’associe à TikTok pour une soirée d’auditions exceptionnelle.
Le temps d’une émission, les créateurs de contenu quittent leur feed pour monter sur la scène. Repérés sur TikTok pour leur créativité, leur univers et leur capacité à rassembler des communautés, ils viennent relever un tout nouveau défi : convaincre le jury en quelques minutes, loin des écrans de smartphone.
Mais une communauté de millions d’abonnés ne garantit pas une place dans la compétition. Comme tous les autres candidats, ils devront obtenir au moins trois « oui » pour poursuivre l’aventure et prouver qu’ils peuvent transformer leur succès numérique en véritable performance de scène.
Chant, danse, humour, performances visuelles ou disciplines totalement inédites… TikTok débarque sur la scène de La France a un incroyable talent avec une nouvelle génération de talents !

programme.title: La roue de la fortune
programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Trouver une consonne leur rapporte de l'argent, tandis que les voyelles sont payantes. À la fin de la cinquième manche, celui ayant amassé le plus d'argent accède à la finale, ce qui lui offre le droit de revenir le lendemain. Lors de la finale, il peut remporter jusqu'à 20 000 euros ou un voyage, à condition de résoudre une ultime énigme en seulement 10 secondes !

Leur but : partager et faire découvrir la plus typique, la plus gourmande, la plus authentique des spécialités locales afin de remporter le titre de meilleur restaurant de leur région. Une compétition faites de secrets culinaires, d’astuces incroyables, de folklore et d’émotion auprès de ceux qui font vivre l’identité gastronomique de nos régions !

programme.title: Wanted : attrape-moi si tu peux !
programme.desc: Dans un lieu tenu secret, 16 célébrités seront « enfermées » dans une « prison », sous la surveillance de trois autres célébrités (Michou, Issa Doumbia, Adil Rami) qui seront leurs gardiens, avec un sens de la provocation et de l’humour qui promet déjà quelques grands moments ! Mais lorsque les portes des cellules s’ouvriront, ce sera le départ du plus grand jeu de poursuite jamais organisé en France !\r\nPendant quatre jours, les 16 célébrités, devenues les « fugitifs » devront tout faire pour ne pas se faire attraper par les trois célébrités « gardiens ». Privés d’argent, de téléphone et de tous leurs repères, les « fugitifs » devront se déplacer, se nourrir, se cacher et « survivre ». Dans une ambiance aussi fun que survoltée, « les gardiens » pourront compter sur un véhicule équipé de tous les outils technologiques mais aussi, et surtout… de vous ! Car pour la première fois en France, les téléspectateurs deviennent acteurs du jeu, en choisissant, via un numéro dédié, d’aider les gardiens… ou de protéger les fugitifs.

Arrivé en 2017 par le Jura, le frelon asiatique est un grand destructeur d'abeilles et autres pollinisateurs, et ses attaques sur l'homme peuvent entraîner des réactions imprévisibles. Reportage au coeur de la lutte en Suisse romande.

Karambolage

programme.desc: L'UFC 333 se déroulera le samedi 24 octobre 2026 à l'Etihad Arena d'Abu Dhabi. Lors de cette soirée, le roi des poids plumes, l'Australien Alexander Volkanovski (28-4), défendra son trône face au Russe invaincu Movsar Evloev. En Co-Main Event, le poids coq russe Petr Yan affrontera le Géorgien Merab Dvalishvili. Dvalishvili avait remporté leur premier duel en 2023, mais Petr Yan avait pris sa revanche en décembre 2025, lors de l'UFC 323 pour redevenir champion. Ce troisième affrontement scellera définitivement le sort de leur rivalité.

Ce dernier, champion des -70 kg d'Hexagone MMA, fait son retour très attendu au KSW pour confirmer sa suprématie face à l'ancien champion polonais de la catégorie. Les deux combattants se sont déjà affrontés en avril 2024 lors d'un combat marquant où Wilson Varela s'était imposé par TKO au deuxième round, après une blessure à l'épaule de Ziolkowski.

programme.title: Au coeur du crime
programme.sub-title: Tu ne convoiteras pas la femme de ton frère
programme.desc: Le 7 décembre 2016, non loin de Valenciennes, dans le Nord) Alexandre Dubrunfaut, 29 ans, est retrouvé carbonisé dans les restes d'une voiture incendiée. Un mois plus tard, son frère David, 32 ans, est interpellé. L'homme a beau nier toute implication, il est pourtant le seul à avoir un mobile convaincant : depuis des mois, sa femme Julie le trompe en effet avec son frère Alexandre. Patrick, au contraire de Ben, entend bien profiter de son célibat et des plaisirs auxquels il avait renoncé durant son mariage. Bientôt rejoints par d’autres divorcés, les fêtards quadragénaires ébauchent les premières règles du "Divorce Club"….

programme.title: Le double expresso RTL2

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Après l'attaque d'une mission humanitaire au Soudan du Sud, un médecin de la Marine et le mari de Jeanne Benoit disparaissent. McGee, Tony et Jeanne partent sur place pour les retrouver, tandis que Gibbs reste à Washington, toujours affaibli par son opération.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Libéré du couloir de la mort pour vice de procédure, un jeune Marine demande au NCIS de l'arrêter afin de démontrer qu'il est innocent du meurtre de son ex-petite amie. De son côté, Bishop surprend son mari avec une collègue des affaires internes et redoute qu'il ait des ennuis avec la NSA.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.sub-title: S13 E10 - Le don de soi
programme.desc: La Secrétaire de la Navy charge le NCIS de retrouver le dernier enfant d'une fratrie militaire. Deux d'entre eux sont morts en service, tandis qu'un troisième attend une greffe vitale. À quelques jours de Thanksgiving, Bishop, réfugiée dans sa famille après l'infidélité de son mari, prend part à l'enquête.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.sub-title: S13 E11 - Jusqu'au bout du monde
programme.desc: Ducky est agressé par un homme qui cherche son demi-frère, Nicholas Mallard, disparu depuis des décennies et que le médecin légiste croyait mort. Tandis que le NCIS traque le suspect, Ducky replonge dans ses souvenirs et revient sur les derniers instants passés avec ce frère qu'il n'a jamais cessé de chercher.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.sub-title: S13 E12 - L'union fait la force
programme.desc: Un jet privé reliant La Nouvelle-Orléans à Washington cesse de répondre. À son atterrissage forcé, les cinq passagers sont retrouvés morts. Dwayne Pride apprend alors à Gibbs que Luca Sciuto, le frère d'Abby, faisait partie des victimes. Employé comme cuisinier dans une société liée à des technologies militaires, il pourrait être au cœur de l'affaire.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: L'épouse et la maîtresse d'un Marine s'accusent mutuellement de son meurtre, obligeant le NCIS à découvrir laquelle ment. De son côté, Anthony DiNozzo Sr. est abordé par une jeune sans-abri persuadée qu'il est son père. Avec l'aide de Tony, il cherche à percer le mystère de son identité.

programme.title: Les apprentis aventuriers
programme.desc: Sacs de 25 kg, insectes et statuette à maintenir en équilibre : la pyramide de la résistance teste les limites des candidats. Au retour, Emi et Anthony s’expliquent sur leur épreuve, qui met leur avenir en jeu.

programme.title: Mylène Farmer - Nevermore 2023/2024
programme.desc: Découvrez « Nevermore 2023/2024 », le concert événement de Mylène Farmer. Avec 14 stades rapidement complets et plus de 600 000 spectateurs, cette tournée est la plus importante jamais proposée en France par une artiste. Retrouvez ses titres emblématiques, de « Sans contrefaçon » à « Désenchantée », dans un spectacle grandiose porté par des décors impressionnants et des chorégraphies iconiques.

programme.title: Mylène Farmer, sans contrefaçon
programme.desc: Mylène Farmer reste l’une des chanteuses françaises les plus mystérieuses. Icône pour plusieurs générations, elle captive le public avec des concerts spectaculaires, conçus comme de véritables shows à l’américaine.\r\nAvec de nombreux disques de diamant à son actif, elle détient aussi le record du nombre de singles classés numéro un au Top 50, avec 13 titres. À travers les étapes clés de sa carrière, découvrez comment cette artiste hors norme est devenue une star incontournable.\r\nComment a-t-elle construit son univers ? Pourquoi est-elle si rare à la télévision ? Et pourquoi a-t-elle parfois envisagé d’arrêter la chanson ?

programme.title: NCIS

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.sub-title: Affaire Travaglini : issue fatale pour un ménage à trois (1/2)
programme.desc:
À 28 ans, Jessy Travaglini avait un nom et un physique de star hollywoodienne. Sublime, intelligente, la jeune mère de famille, épouse d’un entraineur de rugby respecté dans la région de Carpentras, avait tout pour réussir sa vie. Rien ne pouvait laisser penser que cette chargée des ressources humaines, se retrouve un jour dans le box d’une cour d’assises. Et pourtant, la belle est accusée d’un crime terrible : l’assassinat d’une autre mère de famille, Éloïse Bagnolini, 30 ans.
La disparition d’Éloïse est signalée le 11 octobre 2013 par son mari, Alain Castel. Ce jour-là, sa compagne l'avertit par texto qu’exceptionnellement elle ne pourra pas récupérer leur enfant à l'école. Inquiet, en rentrant chez lui à Aubignan, Alain découvre leur domicile en désordre mais aucune trace d’Éloïse. Ses affaires et sa voiture aussi ont disparu. La jeune mère au foyer semble avoir fait ses valises…
Pour le compagnon d’Éloïse, c’est l’incompréhension : le couple semblait nager en plein bonheur, et surtout Éloïse ne serait jamais partie sans son petit garçon de 3 ans. D’ailleurs, les premières constatations des gendarmes dessinent un autre scénario, bien plus sombre celui-ci : du sang d’Éloïse macule le sol, le pommeau de douche est cassé. Ce départ précipité et volontaire serait en fait un crime maquillé… Qui pouvait en vouloir à Éloïse Bagnolini ? A-t-elle été enlevée ? Où est-elle ?
Pour les gendarmes, l’affaire va prendre des allures de crime passionnel car le veuf éploré n’a pas tout dit. Alain, cadre supérieur, entretenait une relation extraconjugale avec une collègue de travail, Jessy Travaglini. Le mari volage serait même devenu son mentor et l’aurait aidée à gravir rapidement les échelons. Coïncidence troublante, le jour de la disparition d’Éloïse, Jessy Travaglini a posé un jour de congé…
La jeune femme serait-elle une croqueuse d’hommes, ambitieuse, "qui ne supporterait pas la concurrence" comme la décrivent ses collègues de travail ? Aurait-elle éliminé sa rivale ? Interpellée, la maîtresse va faire des révélations fracassantes aux enquêteurs : oui, c’est bien elle qui a tué la compagne de son amant… Mais elle aurait agi en état de légitime défense. En fait, c’est Éloïse qui, le matin du drame, alors qu’elle venait de découvrir que son conjoint la trompait, aurait donné rendez-vous à Jessy à son domicile pour régler ses comptes. Agressée violemment, dans la bagarre, Jessy Travaglini aurait accidentellement ôté la vie de la mère de famille. Puis, prise de panique, elle se serait débarrassée du corps en l’enfermant dans le coffre de sa voiture. Éloïse était-elle au courant de la liaison de son mari avec sa collègue ? Alain avait-il mis un terme à sa relation extraconjugale comme il le prétend ? La maîtresse de 53 kilos pour 1m70 a-t-elle pu agir seule ? 
Les gendarmes ne vont pas tarder à découvrir que dans cette affaire, Jessy Travaglini et son amant jouent avec la vérité comme un chat joue avec une souris…

Dans la deuxième partie de l'émission : l'affaire Angélique Six. En 2018, la France est sous le choc : Angélique, 12 ans, a été violée et étranglée à Quesnoy-sur-Deûle, près de Lille. L’émotion est telle que le champion de football Neymar, l’idole d’Angélique, va écrire à la famille. Les policiers enchaînent les fausses pistes mais un témoignage capital va tout relancer : Kilian, 10 ans, aurait vu Angélique avec un homme dans le parc près de son domicile, le jour de sa disparition. Qui est ce mystérieux individu qui accompagnait la jeune adolescente ?
